verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say JavaScript projects should upload source maps for readable stack traces, using the GlitchTip CLI to inject debug IDs and upload them. The CLI supports SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN/SENTRY_URL environment variables and config files, which suits CI use. Missing for 10: the CLI is labeled Beta, no documented source-map upload command or CI example, no first-party bundler plugin (only a general Sentry-API-compatibility claim), and no independent or hands-on confirmation that symbolication works.
